title: Soviet spy at 1950 Pearl Harbor demo; wounded prairie chicken routine
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Soviet spy at 1950 Pearl Harbor demo; wounded prairie chicken routine, about 1950 at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You see, in 1950 during a demo in Pearl Harbor, Brown's work was compromised by a Soviet spy acting as a janitor.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on The Man Who Mastered Gravity, a book by Paul Schatzkin about the scientist Townsend Brown, says that in 1950, during a demonstration of Brown's work at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii, a Soviet spy posing as a janitor compromised it. The story ties this to a ruse called the "wounded prairie chicken" routine, and suggests Brown's gravity research was valuable enough for the Soviets to steal.
